purpose: Test whether relation-algebra constraints and linked counterfactual ordering provide method specificity beyond generic engineered-feature calibration or a source-supervised nonlinear rescorer.

firewall.internal_dev: report all attempt diagnostics without winner-only filtering
firewall.official_validation: retrospective benchmark evaluation of every frozen attempt

family_product.description: existing train-only family logistic compatibility multiplied by source confidence

orbit_projection_product.description: average compatibility over the relation-algebra orbit: close-by endpoint swap or vertical endpoint swap plus inverse predicate; support/contact unchanged

orbit_augmented_product.description: refit the original family feature basis with same-label relation-algebra transforms appended for proximity and relative vertical

pairwise_margin_product.description: refit with BCE plus a fixed pairwise softplus margin between each GT positive and its exported high-margin counterfactual negative

orbit_pairwise_product.description: combine relation-algebra augmentation and linked-counterfactual pairwise loss

orbit_pairwise_projected_product.description: project the combined orbit-plus-pairwise model onto the exact relation-algebra orbit at inference

algebra_basis_product.description: fit only algebra-invariant proximity features and inverse-equivariant vertical features; retain the frozen support/contact calibrator because no valid blanket transform exists

relation_algebra.projection: C_alg(e) = mean_{g in orbit(e)} C(g e)

optimizer.hyperparameter_selection: none; one fixed pairwise setting and all attempts reported

report: linked counterfactual win rate and logit margin
paired confidence intervals against source and existing family product

promotion_gate.all_source_k100_vs_source: delta Recall paired-CI lower bound >= -0.01 and delta verifier-V paired-CI upper bound < 0 on VL-SAT, Open3DSG, and SGFN
promotion_gate.continuity_vs_family_product: delta Recall paired-CI lower bound >= -0.01 on all three sources; report verifier-V direction without winner-only filtering
promotion_gate.novelty: must improve exact structural validity and linked-counterfactual ordering without consuming source score, source identity, or source-specific exact-label supervision
promotion_gate.note: Passing this retrospective development gate can justify a stronger mechanism framing, not prospective confirmation or dataset generalization.
